title: SERVICE-ALLOCATION-B01：三队列服务的学习器与合法固定规则
context: Claim: One paired training instance tests whether multiplicative duration-conditioned action values improve three-queue service over a fully conditioned learner, and whether either learner adds value over a fixed legal queue rule.
